notes: Copy this file to Scripts/library-sources.json and list your own songs, then run Scripts/build_library.py. path: relative to the repository root (Audio/ is git-ignored, a good place for your files) or absolute. genre: lofi, grooves or electronic. status: new (shows the New tag) or inMix. about (optional): vibe is the one-line description shown under the song in the playlist; loop is a longer line kept in the catalog; both in English and Korean. source.songId: optional; a cover picture at Audio/Covers/suno/<songId>.jpeg is used when it exists, otherwise colours are drawn. palette (optional): three "#RRGGBB" colours for the player's background; without it they come from the cover, or are picked for you.

loop.en: One soft pattern on repeat, no tune to follow. It stays in the background.
loop.ko: 부드러운 패턴 하나가 계속 돌아요. 따라갈 멜로디가 없어 배경에 머물러요.
